sn55.8:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā ñātike viharati giñjakāvasathe.
sn55.8:1.3: atha kho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn55.8:3.1: sāḷho ānanda, bhikkhu kālakato, āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi.
sn55.8:3.2: nandā ānanda, bhikkhunī kālakatā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātikā tattha parinibbāyinī anāvattidhammā tasmālokā.
sn55.8:3.3: sudatto ānanda, upāsako kālakato tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmī sakideva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhassantaṃ karissati.
sn55.8:3.4: sujātā ānanda, upāsikā kālakatā tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā sotāpannā avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyaṇā.
sn55.8:4.1: anacchariyaṃ kho panetaṃ ānanda, yaṃ manussabhūto kālaṃ kareyya,
sn55.8:4.2: tasmiṃ tasmiṃ ce maṃ kālakate upasaṅkamitvā etamatthaṃ paṭipucchissatha. vihesāhesā ānanda, assa tathāgatassa.
sn55.8:4.3: tasmātihānanda, dhammādāsaṃ nāma dhammapariyāyaṃ desissāmi. yena samannāgato ariyasāvako ākaṅkhamāno attanāva attānaṃ vyākareyya:
sn55.8:4.4: “khīṇanirayomhi khīṇatiracchānayoniyo khīṇapettivisayo khīṇāpāyaduggativinipāto sotāpannohamasmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo”.
sn55.8:5.1: katamo ca so ānanda, dhammādāyo dhammapariyāyo yena samannāgato ariyasāvako ākaṅkhamāno attanāva attānaṃ vyākareyya
sn55.8:5.2: “khīṇanirayomhi khīṇatiracchānayoniyo khīṇapettivisayo khīṇāpāyaduggativinipāto, sotāpannohamasmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo:
sn55.8:6.1: idhānanda, ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti: “itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti”
sn55.8:6.4: ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi …pe… samādhisaṃvattanikehi.
sn55.8:6.5: ayaṃ kho so ānanda, dhammādāso dhammapariyāyo
sn55.8:6.6: yena samannāgato ariyasāvako ākaṅkhamāno attanāva attānaṃ vyākareyya:
sn55.8:6.7: “khīṇanirayomhi khīṇatiracchānayoniyo khīṇapettivisayo khīṇāpāyaduggativinipāto, sotāpannohamasmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇoti”.
